query: Automotive tariff refunds liquidation protest deadlines

statements.text: The 180-day protest window doesn't pause. A missed deadline can't be undone.
The protest deadline is 180 days from the date of liquidation of the entry.
Within 180 days of liquidation, the importer, their broker, or attorney can contest CBP decisions relating to imported merchandise with a protest under section 514 of the Tariff Act of 1930.
